# `utils/PhysicsBodyPool.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/utils/PhysicsBodyPool.js`

PhysicsBodyPool - Reusable physics body pool for PhysX Pools physics bodies by type to reduce allocation overhead Bodies are reset and reused rather than created/destroyed

## Functions

### `getPooledBody(simMode, colliderShape)`

Get a body handle from pool or signal that new one is needed

**Parameters:**

- `simMode` *(string)* — 'dynamic', 'static', or 'kinematic'
- `colliderShape` *(string)* — 'box', 'sphere', 'capsule', etc.

**Returns:** Body handle if available, null if need to create new

### `releaseBody(physicsWorld, bodyHandle, simMode, colliderShape)`

Return a body to the pool for reuse

**Parameters:**

- `physicsWorld` *(Object)* — PhysX world reference
- `bodyHandle` *(number)* — Body handle to pool
- `simMode` *(string)* — Body simulation mode
- `colliderShape` *(string)* — Collider shape type

### `resetPooledBody(physicsWorld, bodyHandle, position, rotation, scale)`

Reset a pooled body for reuse with new transform

**Parameters:**

- `physicsWorld` *(Object)* — PhysX world reference
- `bodyHandle` *(number)* — Body handle
- `position` *(number[])* — [x, y, z]
- `rotation` *(number[])* — [x, y, z, w] quaternion
- `scale` *(number[])* — [sx, sy, sz]

### `getPoolStats()`

Get pool statistics

### `clearPools(physicsWorld)`

Clear all pools (destroys pooled bodies)

**Parameters:**

- `physicsWorld` *(Object)* — PhysX world reference for cleanup

### `trimPools(keepCount = 5)`

Trim pools to reduce memory

## Re-exports

`BODY_TYPES`

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
